extension.description: Original skin: Andy Morton[CR]Original design: Simon Brunton[CR]Skinner: Julian Michel
extension.news: [B]New[/B][CR]- add support for Kodi v22 (Piers)[CR]- add support for Skin Shortcuts v3[CR]- add Dolby Vision profile to the HDR media flag[CR]- add extra title info, parental rating and backend name to PVR items[CR]- add live bitrates, queue levels and subtitle decoder to the player process info dialog[CR]- add spinner to the weather widget while it updates[CR]- add last update time to the weather window[CR][CR][B]Improved[/B][CR]- allow stepping through subtitles in both directions in the video OSD[CR]- open the subtitle settings from the subtitle name in the video OSD[CR]- name audio and subtitle streams by their stream name in the video OSD and fullscreen info[CR]- detect Dolby Atmos and DTS:X from the stream instead of the file name[CR]- separate genres, directors and writers with commas[CR]- hide duration based information during live playback[CR]- consolidate codec and audio channel labels into shared lookup maps[CR]- allow any item limit to be set for main menu widgets[CR]- localise the artwork type names in the main menu widget artwork pickers[CR]- offer every artwork type when picking main menu widget artwork, rather than only the ones the widget's content provides[CR]- remove the always show settings link setting, as the settings item can no longer be taken off the main menu[CR]- offer date sorting on live TV and radio widgets[CR]- disable the delete and hide buttons on menu items that cannot be removed, and the restore button while nothing has been deleted[CR]- give every group in the shortcut and widget pickers its own icon[CR]- name the reset button in the skin settings for everything it clears, which is every menu and every view selection[CR][CR][B]Fixed[/B][CR]- fix audio channel labels claiming layouts a channel count cannot identify[CR]- fix the recently added artists widget pointing at a playlist that does not exist[CR]- fix the music add-on widget resolving to nothing[CR]- fix the widget property pickers showing a crossed circle beside every option[CR]- fix the live TV and radio widgets opening the videos window rather than their own[CR]- fix the video watched status setting leaving movie sets untouched[CR]- fix the rip disc row and the artist widgets pointing at artwork the skin does not ship[CR]- fix video widgets falling back to music artwork[CR]- fix the movie sets, music nodes and custom widgets carrying a type that does not describe their content[CR]- fix the weather widget being recognised by a property Skin Shortcuts v3 never sets[CR]- fix the seeded live TV and radio widgets differing from the ones the picker writes[CR]- fix the three widget artwork slots drawing over one another[CR]- fix the Skin Shortcuts entry points showing while the add-on is disabled
